title: Guided Workflows
description: Create and inspect scientific workflow plans that require explicit researcher approval before execution.

tools.name: workflow_list_templates
tools.description: List the guided scientific workflow templates available in this Molemo runtime.

tools.name: workflow_create_plan
tools.description: Create a concrete scientific workflow plan in pending-approval state. This tool never executes or approves the plan.

inputs.description: Concrete inputs required by the selected template.

objective.description: The user's research objective for this run.

tools.name: workflow_get_run
tools.description: Inspect the status, steps, trace, and artifacts of an existing workflow run.
